name: Transactional Commit Engine & Canonical Service Delegation

pricingAnalysis.architecturalJustification: Pricing rules are master contract configurations defined prior to operations by Project Admins. In the import pipeline (Blocks 120-126), pricing data is read-only reference data used during validation (BLOCK 122) and referenced via immutable pricingSnapshotId on trip records. Bulk import does not create/update pricing rules.

exceptionAnalysis.architecturalJustification: In the import pipeline (Blocks 120-126), validation issues and duplicate conflicts are captured as pre-commit review findings inside the Review Artifact (BLOCK 124). Blocking issues prevent approval (BLOCK 125). Operational exception records (BLOCK 111) are raised by live field operations during trip execution, not created during bulk batch commit.

partialFailureAndRollback.description: All domain writes (Trip, Driver, Truck, Roster, SyncOperation, ImportBatch) and session state updates occur inside the runTransaction callback. If any step throws, Firestore discards all staged writes atomically.
